```{r}

# Load invasive status predictions from NIClassify + BLAST mapping
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |> 
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)

# Load BLAST/IBIS predictions from Excel (manual curation)
status_blast <- read.xlsx(here::here("output/tax_invasive.xlsx")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_genus)

# Combine and clean all invasion status sources
status <- status |> 
  left_join(status_blast, by = "zotu_id") |> 
  dplyr::rename(ibis_status = status_final) |> 
  # Convert blank strings to NA
  mutate(across(c(ibis_status, status_ni, status_genus), 
                ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x))) |> 
  # Normalize case and rename columns for clarity
  mutate(
    Ibis      = tolower(ibis_status), 
    NiClassify= tolower(status_ni), 
    Blast     = tolower(status_genus),
    zotu_id   = tolower(zotu_id)
  ) |> 
  select(-contains("status"))  # drop original status columns
```

# Comparing Invasive Status Predictions vs Blast or Ibis
```{r}

summary_stats <- status |> 
  #calculate % introduces vs native vs NA for each method 
  #first pivot longer
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Ibis, NiClassify, Blast), 
               names_to = "method", values_to = "status") |>
  group_by(method, status) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  #pivot wider for nicer table
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) |> 
  dplyr::rename("No information available" = "NA")


# Use gt to export a publication-ready summary table
summary_stats |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Summary of Invasive Status Predictions") |> 
  cols_label(method = "Prediction Method") |> 
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0) |> 
  cols_width(everything() ~ px(150)) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Invasive Status", 
    columns = c("introduced", "native", "No information available")
  ) |> 
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Data obtained through Ibis geolocation API, NIClassify predictions, BLAST mapping and species lookup"
  ) 
```

# 🌱🌲🌳 Leke Transect Tree Comparison – Cleaned Code Chunk

```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. Filter metadata to Leke samples (ʻŌhiʻa, Koa, Guava on Oʻahu)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
meta_leke <- meta_data |> 
  filter(tolower(island) == "oahu") |> 
  filter(str_detect(sample_id, "O_|K_|G_")) |>   # O = ʻŌhiʻa, K = Koa, G = Guava
  select(sample_id, sample_site, commonname)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. Convert ZOTU table to long format, join tree metadata
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
zotu_long <- zotu_df |> 
  inner_join(meta_leke, by = "sample_id") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("zotu"), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "count") |> 
  filter(count > 0) |>             # ← This is key
  distinct(zotu, commonname) |>    # ← Ensure no duplicate combinations
  mutate(present = TRUE)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. Build presence/absence matrix per tree species (commonname)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
zotu_presence <- zotu_long |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = commonname, values_from = present, values_fill = FALSE) |> 
  inner_join(status |> select(zotu_id, NiClassify, Blast), by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) |> 
  mutate(
    NiClassify = tolower(coalesce(NiClassify, "unknown")),
    Blast      = tolower(coalesce(Blast,      "unknown")),
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown")),
    Blast      = factor(Blast,      levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"))) 


```

# 📊 Plot 3: UpSet plot by BLAST status as example 

```{r UpSet-Blast-NIClassify, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=12}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Lekes Transect – UpSet plots colored by invasion status (NIClassify + BLAST)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


# 4. Color palettes
niclassify_colors <- c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C")
blast_colors      <- c(native = "#33A02C", introduced = "#B15928")

# 5. Tree-specific colors
plant_colors <- c(
  "ʻōhiʻa Lehua"  = "#C1133D",   # ʻōhiʻa Lehua
  "koa"   = "#8B4513",   # koa
  "strawberry guava" = "gold"       # strawberry guava
)

# 6. NIClassify Upset with colored matrix
ni_leke <- upset(
  zotu_presence,
  intersect = c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua", "koa", "strawberry guava"),
  name = "Shared ASVs",
  width_ratio = 0.15,

  # Bottom matrix: colored by tree species
  matrix = (
    intersection_matrix(
      geom = geom_point(shape = "circle filled", size = 3)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = plant_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = "circle"))
    )
  ),

  # Queries: row highlight stripes
  queries = list(
    upset_query(set = "ʻōhiʻa Lehua",     fill = plant_colors[["ʻōhiʻa Lehua"]]),
    upset_query(set = "koa",              fill = plant_colors[["koa"]]),
    upset_query(set = "strawberry guava", fill = plant_colors[["strawberry guava"]])
  ),

  # Top barplot: colored by NIClassify with totals
  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = (
      ggplot(mapping = aes(x = intersection, fill = NiClassify)) +
        geom_bar(color = "black") +
        geom_text(
          aes(label = after_stat(count), group = 1),
          stat = "count",
          vjust = -0.4,
          size = 4,
          fontface = "bold",
          color = "black"
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = niclassify_colors,
          name   = "NIClassify",
          drop   = FALSE
        ) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Summed ASVs") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = c(0.8, 0.85),
          legend.justification = c(1, 1),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), color = NA)
        )
    )
  )
)




# 7. BLAST Upset with colored matrix
blast_leke <- upset(
  zotu_presence,
  intersect = c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua", "koa", "strawberry guava"),
  name = "Shared ASVs",
  width_ratio = 0.15,

  # Bottom matrix: colored by tree species
  matrix = (
    intersection_matrix(
      geom = geom_point(shape = "circle filled", size = 3)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = plant_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = "circle"))
    )
  ),

  # Queries: row highlight stripes
  queries = list(
    upset_query(set = "ʻōhiʻa Lehua",     fill = plant_colors[["ʻōhiʻa Lehua"]]),
    upset_query(set = "koa",              fill = plant_colors[["koa"]]),
    upset_query(set = "strawberry guava", fill = plant_colors[["strawberry guava"]])
  ),

  # Top barplot: colored by NIClassify with totals
  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = (
      ggplot(mapping = aes(x = intersection, fill = Blast)) +
        geom_bar(color = "black") +
        geom_text(
          aes(label = after_stat(count), group = 1),
          stat = "count",
          vjust = -0.4,
          size = 4,
          fontface = "bold",
          color = "black"
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = blast_colors,
          name   = "NCBI Blastn",
          drop   = FALSE
        ) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Summed ASVs") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = c(0.8, 0.85),
          legend.justification = c(1, 1),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), color = NA)
        )
    )
  )
)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 8. Combine both UpSet plots into a single figure
wrap_plots(blast_leke, ni_leke, ncol = 1)
```

UpSet plots showing shared and unique zOTUs across co-occurring native (ʻōhiʻa, koa) and introduced (strawberry guava) trees on Oʻahu. Bars are colored by invasion status as inferred from BLAST matches (top) and NIClassify predictions (bottom).

```{r}

paired_status <- zotu_presence |>
  filter(!is.na(NiClassify), !is.na(Blast)) |>
  select(zotu, NiClassify, Blast) |>
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown")),
    Blast      = factor(Blast,      levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"))
  )

paired_long <- paired_status |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NiClassify, Blast), names_to = "classifier", values_to = "status") |>
  group_by(zotu) |>
  filter(n_distinct(classifier) == 2) |>  # Each zotu must have both classifiers
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    zotu       = factor(zotu),                              # ← fix here
    classifier = factor(classifier, levels = c("NiClassify", "Blast")),
    status     = factor(status, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"))
  )

symm_test <- coin::symmetry_test(
  status ~ classifier | zotu,
  data = paired_long,
  teststat = "quad",
  distribution = "asymptotic"
)

symm_test

```

We found a significant difference in invasion status assignments between BLAST and NIClassify across zOTUs (asymptotic symmetry test, χ² = 51.97, df = 1, p = 5.6 × 10⁻¹³), demonstrating that the choice of classifier impacts ecological interpretation of community composition.

# 📊 Supl. Plot : Heatmap of Confusion Matrix

```{r}
# Calculate confusion matrix
conf_mat <- zotu_presence |>
  count(NiClassify, Blast) |>
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown")),
    Blast = factor(Blast, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"))
  )

# Heatmap of the confusion matrix
conf_mat_plot <- ggplot(conf_mat, aes(x = Blast, y = NiClassify, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), fontface = "bold", size = 5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#ffffff", high = "#b2182b", name = "Count") +
  labs(
    x = "BLAST Status",
    y = "NIClassify Status",
    title = "Disagreement between BLAST and NIClassify"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

conf_mat_plot

```

Figure X. Confusion matrix comparing invasion status assignments for zOTUs by BLAST (x-axis) and NIClassify (y-axis) on the Lekes transect. Cell values represent the number of zOTUs assigned to each combination. The majority of assignments are "introduced" by both classifiers, but a considerable number are classified as "native" by NIClassify and "introduced" by BLAST, indicating a significant difference in classifier behavior (symmetry test, p \< 0.001).

```{r}

# Add elevation bands (terciles) directly within meta_data if not already present
ohia_meta <- meta_data %>%
  filter(tolower(island) == "oahu",
         !sample_id %in% c("KT1", "KA5"),
         shortname == "Ohia") |> 
  mutate(
    elev_band = cut(
      elevation_m,
      breaks = quantile(elevation_m, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
      labels = c("low", "mid", "high"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) |> 
  distinct(sample_id, sample_site, elevation_m, elev_band)



# Merge with ZOTUs and NIClassify status
plot_meta <- zotu_df %>%
  inner_join(ohia_meta, by = "sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("sample_id", "elev_band", "sample_site"), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(status %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify), by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) %>%
  left_join(ohia_meta, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(
      if_else(NiClassify == "introduced", "introduced", "native"),
      levels = c("native", "introduced")
    ),
    elev_band = factor(elev_band, levels = c("low", "mid", "high"))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(NiClassify)

```

# ⛰️ Elevation Bands and Invasion Status across all Oahu ridges

# 📊 Plot 4: Invasion among elevation bands

```{r}

# Count number of unique samples per group
sample_counts <- plot_meta %>%
  distinct(sample_id, sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  summarise(sample_n = n(), .groups = "drop")


# Summarize
elev_df <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band, NiClassify) %>%
  summarise(zotus = n_distinct(zotu), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  mutate(pct = zotus / sum(zotus)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Make short names for x-axis labels if needed
elev_df <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band, NiClassify) %>%
  summarise(zotus = n_distinct(zotu), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  mutate(pct = zotus / sum(zotus)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(sample_counts, by = c("sample_site", "elev_band")) %>%
  mutate(
    x_label = paste0(sample_site, " ", elev_band, " (n=", sample_n, ")")
  )



# Explicit order for sites and elevation bands
x_levels <- elev_df %>%
  distinct(sample_site, elev_band, x_label) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(sample_site, levels = c("Ka'ala", "Schofield-Waikane", "Poamoho", "Manana", "ʻAiea")),
    factor(elev_band, levels = c("low", "mid", "high"))
  ) %>%
  pull(x_label)

elev_df <- elev_df %>%
  mutate(x_label = factor(x_label, levels = x_levels))


# Plot
ggplot(elev_df, aes(x = x_label, y = pct, fill = NiClassify)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = "stack", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C"),
    name   = "NiClassify Status"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Percent of zOTUs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

Stacked bar chart showing the percentage of unique zOTUs, classified as native (blue) or introduced (red), within each elevation band—low, mid, and high—across the five Oʻahu ridges: Ka‘ala, Schofield-Waikane, Poamoho, Manana, and ʻAiea. Elevation bands were defined by the 33rd and 67th percentile breaks of sampled elevations for each ridge, with the number of samples per band shown in parentheses on the x-axis (n). The consistently higher proportion of introduced zOTUs at lower elevations—particularly on Manana and ʻAiea—contrasts with a greater native zOTU representation at higher bands, suggesting an elevation-dependent invasion gradient in Oʻahu’s ʻōhiʻa forests.

```{r}
# Build summary: one row per sample_id × site × elevation band
inv_by_sample <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, sample_id, elev_band) %>%
  summarise(
    introduced = sum(NiClassify == "introduced"),
    native     = sum(NiClassify == "native"),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

# Add ridge_id for clustering (1:5 for your ridges, order as in your plot)
inv_by_sample <- inv_by_sample %>%
  mutate(
    ridge_id = as.numeric(factor(sample_site, levels = c("Ka'ala", "Schofield-Waikane", "Poamoho", "Manana", "ʻAiea")))
  )

gee2 <- geepack::geeglm(
  cbind(introduced, native) ~ elev_band,
  id = ridge_id,
  data = inv_by_sample,
  family = binomial,
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)
summary(gee2)

```

We used a binomial Generalized Estimating Equation (GEE) to test the effect of elevation band (low, mid, high) on the proportion of introduced zOTUs, with ridge as the clustering variable.

The model revealed a significant effect of elevation band (Wald χ² = 9.95, df = 2, p = 0.007), with both the mid (estimate = –0.55, p = 0.025) and high (estimate = –0.46, p = 0.0016) elevation bands showing significantly lower odds of introduced zOTUs compared to the low band.

# 📊 Plot 6: Statistical differences of invasion between tree species on ʻAiea and Manana ridges

```{r}

# 1) Re-compute per-sample proportions (introduced out of all classified+unclassified)
prop_df <- zotu_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to="zotu", values_to="count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_data %>% select(sample_id, sample_site, shortname),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sample_site %in% c("ʻAiea","Manana"),
    shortname   %in% c("Ohia","Koa","Guava")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    status %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify) %>% rename(zotu = zotu_id),
    by = "zotu"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = coalesce(NiClassify, "unclassified"),
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels=c("native","introduced","unclassified"))
  ) %>%
  count(sample_id, sample_site, shortname, NiClassify) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(NiClassify=="introduced") %>%
  transmute(
    sample_id,
    sample_site,
    tree        = recode(shortname,
                         "Ohia"  = "ʻōhiʻa Lehua",
                         "Koa"   = "koa",
                         "Guava" = "strawberry guava"),
    prop_intro = n / total
  )

# 2) Define the 3 pair-wise comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua","koa"),
  c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua","strawberry guava"),
  c("koa","strawberry guava")
)

# 3) Build the bar + SE plot with significance stars
ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = tree, y = prop_intro, fill = tree)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", fun="mean", width=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(stat="summary", fun.data=mean_se, width=0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_site, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy=1),
    limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.2), expand = c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plant_colors) +
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(label = ..p.signif..),
    method           = "t.test",
    comparisons      = comparisons,
    p.adjust.method  = "holm",
    hide.ns          = FALSE,
    tip.length       = 0.01
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "Tree species",
    y        = "Mean % introduced zOTUs ± SE",
    fill     = "Tree"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    legend.position= "none",
    strip.text     = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

# Summary invasion status analysis

Data & status integration. We merged NIClassify predictions with curated BLAST/IBIS assignments, normalized case, and treated blanks as NA. Status was summarized per method (native / introduced / unknown) with a gt table. Tree comparisons (Leke transect). Presence/absence per ZOTU across ʻōhiʻa, koa, and guava; intersections visualized with ComplexUpset. Top bars colored by NIClassify or BLAST status. Classifier disagreement. For ZOTUs with both assignments, we tested symmetry of the 2×2 status table (native vs introduced) across classifiers using coin::symmetry_test with ZOTU as a blocking factor. Elevation effects (ʻōhiʻa on Oʻahu). We assigned elevation bands (terciles), computed % introduced per site×band, plotted stacked bars, and fit a binomial GEE (introduced vs native) with ridge as cluster. Ridge overlap. UpSet across five ridges with NIClassify coloring. Tree contrasts within ridges. Mean % introduced per tree, SE bars, pairwise tests with Holm correction (stars plotted).

Results support H2: introduced taxa are more prevalent at lower elevations, with a consistent decline up the gradient.

Combined with your TITAN (\~500 m community breakpoint), this suggests a transition zone where lower-elevation assemblages (richer in introduced taxa) give way to higher-elevation assemblages.

H3 (site effects): UpSet/ridge panels and GEE clustering by ridge indicate ridge/site structure matters beyond elevation alone; we’re not just seeing a smooth cline.
